g.text: Figure 10: source envelopes and reconstruction · mobile share 0.5
Points: individual original observations. Census: complete/required; O=original, F=fresh; defined clustering and extinction counts. Source bands: digitization
envelopes, not paper confidence intervals. Predictive bands: simulated 30-history replications, not confidence intervals for source or N=100 means.
Missing/unreadable source points and undefined clustering retain gaps.
